value.rationale: The seven-vertex case is the first regular-tournament order with multiple nonisomorphic types and hence a natural nontrivial finite test of the longstanding Brualdi-Li sharp-diameter question. Exact radius, diameter and complete antipodal classification separate metric geometry from previously known connectivity, degree and census; the complete distance profiles provide structural benchmarking for triangle-reversal dynamics. No general-order extrapolation is needed for this finite classification to be meaningful.
